    efetch

    efetch.Rd

    search NCBI db using esearch API. this function is under development the function returns Returns formatted data records for a list of input UIDs Returns formatted data records for a set of UIDs stored on the Entrez History server

    efetch(
  id = NA,
  input = NA,
  query_key,
  WebEnv,
  db = "pubmed",
  format = c("docsum", "full", "uilist", "summary", "gene_table", "gb", "gbc", "ft",
    "gbwithparts", "fasta_cds_na", "fasta_cds_aa", "gp", "gpc", "ipg"),
  retmode = c("xml", "text", "asn.1")
)

    Arguments

    id

    (required) Unique identifier or accession number. NCBI uid. vector object.

    input

    Read identifier(s) from file (one line).

    db

    (required) Database name. NCBI DBs were described in details.

    retmode

    (optional) determine if the output is XML/plain text. the option will override user input if there is only one option is available.

    api_key

    (optional) NCBI api_key. you can get your own api_key from NCBI setting page after log-in. To use the function easily, you need to declare "NCBI_API_KEY" in .Renviron file.

    usehistory

    T/F. save result in your search history. you can also get WebEnv information. (default=T)

    retstart

    (optional) number of skipping from the search (Default=0)

    retmax

    (optional) total number of unique identifiers from the retrived set to be shown in the output (default=20)

    rettype

    (optional) (optional) "uilist" or "count" (default="uilist"). if the value is count, the function only redirects the total number of query results.

    datetype

    (optional) one from c("crdt","edat","pdat","mhda")

    Value

    list or vector object.
